info.title: XpertAI SDK HTTP API
info.description: Current HTTP endpoints used by the SDK guide. Authenticate with a server-side API Key using Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> or x-api-key. These endpoints do not require ChatKit. The reference covers the guide examples, not every method exported by the SDK. Check deployment support before using additional fields.

post.description: Create a thread before starting a run. For agent conversations, include `assistant_id` and use the same agent ID for the run. The protocol accepts `{}` for an unbound thread, but successful creation does not establish run permission. Save `thread_id` for subsequent requests and `metadata.conversation_id` when a conversation ID is required. Creating a thread does not start the agent. If the run returns 403, see the permission troubleshooting section in the [SDK guide](/en/ai/agent/development-api).

assistant_id.description: Optional at the protocol level. For agent conversations, supply the target published agent ID at creation and use the same ID for subsequent runs. The TypeScript SDK parameter is `assistantId`. If omitted, the thread is created without an agent binding under the current request identity; a later run using a different execution identity can fail with 403. Binding does not grant additional conversation access.

post.description: Start a new run and stream its output. Save run_id from the Content-Location response header. For reconnection use `GET /api/ai/threads/{thread_id}/runs/{run_id}/stream`; repeating this POST can execute the task again. The body uses assistant_id and input, not the legacy request/options envelope.
